notablePrerequisites:
You control two creatures excluding Magus of the Candelabra that do not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.
description:
Activate two creatures other than Magus of the Candelabra by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and tapping it, untapping it and the two other creatures.
Repeat.
